title: Pairing-Swap Interaction Diagnostic
kind: inference-only; two-stage gated; no training; no p-value

geometry.sign: right[y,x] = left[y,x+t] => d = x_L - x_R = +t px

statistic.profile: Ibar_tau(k) = median over mask of I_tau(k,.,.)
statistic.h: sum over tau in {1..6} of hit

mask.right_bound_derivation: shift_left zero-fills feature cols [71-k,71), max k=11 -> [60,71); aggregation spatial radius 5 cells; upsample slop 1 -> safe iff w+6<60 -> w<54 -> x<864

scenes.selection_rule: twelve lowest unused indices ascending, paired consecutively

gate_decision.G_STOP: max(h_rand) == 6 -> FINAL VERDICT STATISTIC-ARCHITECTURALLY-AVAILABLE; STOP; trained weights NOT loaded; terminal
gate_decision.G_PASS: max(h_rand) < 6 -> record H* = max(h_rand), unaltered, proceed to Stage 2

decision.CASE_A: min(h_trained) > H* AND all three checkpoints separate AND all six pairs separate
decision.CASE_B: trained responses overlap the random reference -> NOT-DEMONSTRATED (not evidence of absence)
decision.CASE_C: any partial or heterogeneous separation -> never promoted to a pass
decision.TRACKING_WITH_OFFSET: h low but anchor c_tau - tau identical across all six tau
decision.vertical_downgrade: if the vertical interaction systematically tracks under the same criterion -> CASE C

search_free.reporting: SEPARATE; never mixed into the null; never redefines H*

right_image_corruption.reason: perturbs a main effect, which cancels identically in the interaction

hard_stops.HS1: geometry mapping verified FROM THE ARRAYS: right[:, :-t]==left[:, t:] (horizontal), right[:-t, :]==left[t:, :] (vertical); and max|V[:,tau,:,w<54]|==0.0 exactly for horizontal POSITIVE cells
hard_stops.HS2: exact AA/BB/AB/BA construction; each frame exactly once as left and once as right
hard_stops.HS3: tau identical across the four cells of a level
hard_stops.HS4: max|V_AA+V_BB-V_AB-V_BA| / max|V_AB| <= 1e-5 (bound from float32 round-off, 10x margin)
hard_stops.HS5: checkpoint sha256 match; num_disparities==12; cost_volume_shift as specified; readout parameter count == 0
hard_stops.HS7: no trained aggregation loaded before G-PASS; Stage 1 sets model.aggregation=None after load and contains no Stage-2 code path
hard_stops.HS8: no historical record modified; prior sha256 re-verified before and after
hard_stops.HS11: no optimizer, no .backward(), no .step(), refinement never invoked

hard_stop_policy: STOP IMMEDIATELY. The experiment is not repaired and continued.

determinism.W4: one complete unit recomputed in a fresh process; full response vector bit-identical
